name: Special Meeting of the Azusa Utility Board
agenda_text:
NOTICE AND CALL OF A SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE AZUSA UTILITY BOARD

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that a Special Meeting of the Azusa Utility Board is hereby called pursuant
to Government Code Section 54956, to be held on Friday, June 27th at 6:00 a.m., at the Water Treatment
Plant – Open to the Public, located at 1870 Ranch Road, Azusa, California, for the purpose of
considering the following:

  PRELIMINARY BUSINESS
  1. Call To Order
  2. Roll Call

 A. PUBLIC COMMENT – Limited to items listed on this Special Meeting Notice

 B. SITE VISIT OF SOUTH RESERVOIR PROJECT

  Azusa Utility Board will participate in a site visit of the South Reservoir Project. Please note: Anyone
  wishing to attend will need to provide their own Transportation. No action will be voted on.

 C. ADJOURNMENT

  End Meeting at the South Reservoir Site.

Dated: June 25, 2025

________________________  _____________________________
Robert Gonzales, Mayor  Jeffrey L. Cornejo, Jr., City Clerk

DECLARATION OF NOTIFICATION AND POSTING:

I, Yesenia Paez, Senior Management Analyst, or my designee, hereby certify that on the 25th day of June,
2025, I e-mailed a true copy of the above notice as follows:

 Chairperson Edward J. Alvarez
 Vice Chairperson Jesse Avila, Jr.
 Board Member Andrew N. Mendez
 Board Member Robert Gonzales
 Board Member Sabrina Bow, Ed.D.

NOTE: Above addresses on file and posted said notice in the City Clerk’s Office and the Civic
Auditorium, 213 E. Foothill Blvd.; the Azusa Light & Water Lobby, 729 N. Azusa Ave., the City Library,
729 N. Dalton Ave.; and on the City’s Web Page at www.azusaca.gov on June 25th, 2025. I declare under
penalty of perjury that the foregoing statement is true and correct.

  ________________________________
  Yesenia Paez, Declarant
